root_cause: The connected import shell fetched the owner's saved timetable but did not pass its reviewed term calendar to ImportPage. Raw extension observation JSON has no TermCalendar; choosing the file therefore waited for calendar confirmation rather than starting parsing. Even standard timetable files carrying a calendar waited unnecessarily.
reproduction: On the old deployed UI, selected the user's previously provided timetable-import.json through the file picker. It was received successfully but the page remained in the pending-calendar state despite an existing saved timetable.
changes: Asynchronously reuse only this owner's confirmed saved term calendar for same-term file imports
Read confirmed embedded calendars from complete timetable JSON
Require review instead of silently using an old term when selectedTerm differs
Keep pending files until initial calendar review finishes, then automatically parse without reselecting
FileReader fallback where mobile browsers lack File.text; UTF-8 BOM compatibility
Keep local preview, explicit draft generation and explicit final replacement confirmation

verification.import_core_suite: 57 passed, 2 optional private-file tests skipped; additional BOM regression passed separately
verification.authorized_private_json_test: Passed; file-import payload exactly equals direct extension-observation payload for the same reviewed calendar and captured_at
verification.live_file_picker: Same user JSON automatically parsed into 10 courses; no alerts; draft-generation button enabled
verification.writes_during_live_acceptance: No draft generated and no timetable committed; existing personal data preserved
verification.physical_mobile_acceptance: Not performed. Viewport override did not take effect; the live screenshot is desktop, not a mobile proof.

limits: Phone users can select an already exported JSON file. Direct cross-site reading of the authenticated teaching system from a plain mobile webpage is not implemented. First-time raw observation import still needs the user to supply and review the calendar.
